license_status: No repository LICENSE file and GitHub license metadata is null; commercial/redistribution rights were not established.
checkpoint_source: bundled in repository at models/PTv1/point_best_model.pth (README: Pretrained model is at models/PTv1/point_best_model.pth)

point_best_model.pth.role: CrossTooth PTv1 point feature segmentation checkpoint

requirements.pointops: required from POSTECH-CVLab/point-transformer (CUDA extension); imported as models.PointTransformer.libs.pointops.functions.pointops but PointTransformer tree is absent from the published repo checkout
requirements.input: PLY mesh readable by vedo (sample YBSESUN6_upper.ply); STL is not the documented official predict input and must be converted only in research area if a future run is unblocked
requirements.pipeline: face-centroid + cell-normal point features -> PointTransformerSeg38 (19 logits) -> argmax labels -> colored face mask PLY

input_format.loader: dataset/data.py ToothData uses vedo.load(item); computes cell centroids and cell normals; samples/pads to num_points=16000 with random permutation

correspondence.original_vertices_in_output: output_pred_ply writes original mesh.points() as vertices and colored faces from predicted face labels
correspondence.sampling: random permutation and PointcloudSample to 16000 faces; padding faces with (0,0,0) indices skipped on write
correspondence.vertex_label_identity: labels are assigned per sampled face, not per original vertex index; full original-vertex semantic labels are not produced by the official path
correspondence.stl_vertex_face_preservation: not verified on this host because inference was blocked before conversion/run

execution.device_selection: args.cuda = (not args.no_cuda) and torch.cuda.is_available(); model moved to cuda if available else cpu flag path exists
execution.hard_cuda_in_model: models/PTv1/point_transformer_seg.py uses torch.cuda.IntTensor and pointops CUDA ops (furthestsampling, queryandgroup); no CPU-safe official path

blockers: Official stack requires CUDA 11.7 PyTorch and CUDA pointops
Published repo checkout lacks models/PointTransformer pointops sources
Model code hard-codes CUDA tensors in TransitionDown

connected_component_experiment.reason: No official prediction masks were produced because inference was blocked

tooth_instance_compatibility.notes: Public code maps class indices 1-16 to UL/UR/LL/LR color names and includes an FDI2color table, and predict.py always applies lower_palette; without a successful official run, instance identity, FDI correctness, confidence, and original-mesh reconstruction remain unverified. Expected product behavior is semantic class labels on faces rather than a complete ToothInstance pipeline.

failures: Host cannot execute official CUDA/pointops inference path
